```{python}
# plot total data centers by state over time
state_tot_by_year = df[["year", "estabs", "county_id"]]
state_tot_by_year["state_id"] = state_tot_by_year["county_id"].astype(str).str[:2]

fips_to_state = {
    "01": "AL", "02": "AK", "04": "AZ", "05": "AR", "06": "CA",
    "08": "CO", "09": "CT", "10": "DE", "11": "DC", "12": "FL",
    "13": "GA", "15": "HI", "16": "ID", "17": "IL", "18": "IN",
    "19": "IA", "20": "KS", "21": "KY", "22": "LA", "23": "ME",
    "24": "MD", "25": "MA", "26": "MI", "27": "MN", "28": "MS",
    "29": "MO", "30": "MT", "31": "NE", "32": "NV", "33": "NH",
    "34": "NJ", "35": "NM", "36": "NY", "37": "NC", "38": "ND",
    "39": "OH", "40": "OK", "41": "OR", "42": "PA", "44": "RI",
    "45": "SC", "46": "SD", "47": "TN", "48": "TX", "49": "UT",
    "50": "VT", "51": "VA", "53": "WA", "54": "WV", "55": "WI",
    "56": "WY"
    }

state_tot_by_year["state"] = state_tot_by_year["state_id"].map(fips_to_state)
state_tot_by_year = state_tot_by_year[["year", "estabs", "state"]]
state_tot_by_year = state_tot_by_year.groupby(by=['year', 'state']).sum()
state_tot_by_year = state_tot_by_year.reset_index()

top_states = state_tot_by_year.groupby("state").mean()
top_states = top_states.sort_values(by=['estabs'], ascending=False)
top_states = top_states.reset_index()
top_states = top_states.loc[0:10,"state"]

only_top_states_data = state_tot_by_year[state_tot_by_year["state"].isin(top_states.to_list())]

sns.lineplot(data=only_top_states_data, x="year", y="estabs", hue='state')
plt.show()
```


### Geographic Distribution

```{python}
# load counties map data
geojson_path = data_dir / "county_fips_codes/geojson_counties_fips.json"

with open(geojson_path, "r") as f:
    counties_geojson = json.load(f)
```
```{python}
# define map layout function
def apply_map_layout_and_controls(fig, title_text, years):
    """
    Applies the carto-positron map style, playback menus, and time sliders
    to an existing Plotly animation figure.
    """
    fig.update_layout(
        title=title_text,
        map=dict(
            style="carto-positron",
            center=dict(lat=37.8, lon=-96),
            zoom=3
        ),
        margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=50, b=0),
        updatemenus=[
            dict(
                type="buttons",
                showactive=False,
                x=0.05,
                y=0.95,
                buttons=[
                    dict(
                        label="Play",
                        method="animate",
                        args=[None, {"frame": {"duration": 700, "redraw": True}, "transition": {"duration": 300}, "fromcurrent": True}]
                    ),
                    dict(
                        label="Pause",
                        method="animate",
                        args=[[None], {"frame": {"duration": 0, "redraw": False}, "transition": {"duration": 0}, "mode": "immediate"}]
                    )
                ]
            )
        ],
        sliders=[
            dict(
                active=0,
                currentvalue={"prefix": "Year: "},
                pad={"t": 30},
                steps=[
                    dict(
                        label=str(int(y)),
                        method="animate",
                        args=[[str(int(y))], {"frame": {"duration": 0, "redraw": True}, "transition": {"duration": 0}, "mode": "immediate"}]
                    )
                    for y in years
                ]
            )
        ]
    )
    return fig
```

#### Missingness Check
```{python}
# create map of counties for which we have data over time
def plot_county_coverage(df, table_name, value_col):
    map_df = df[["year", "county_id"]].dropna().drop_duplicates()
    years = sorted(map_df["year"].unique())
    frames = []

    # Compile chronological frame tracking data
    for year in years:
        df_year = map_df[map_df["year"] == year]
        frames.append(
            go.Frame(
                data=[
                    go.Choroplethmap(
                        locations=df_year["county_id"],
                        z=[1] * len(df_year),  
                    )
                ],
                name=str(int(year))
            )
        )

    if not frames:
        raise ValueError(f"No valid yearly data found for {table_name}")

    # Create base map matching geojson object
    initial_year_data = map_df[map_df["year"] == years[0]]
    fig = go.Figure(
        data=[
            go.Choroplethmap(
                geojson=counties_geojson, # References global object directly
                locations=initial_year_data["county_id"],
                z=[1] * len(initial_year_data),
                featureidkey="id",
                colorscale=[[0, "#fff9f9"], [1, "#2cb94f"]],
                zmin=0,
                zmax=1,
                marker_opacity=0.35,
                marker_line_width=0.3,
                showscale=False,
                hovertemplate="County FIPS: %{location}<br>Has data: Yes<extra></extra>"
            )
        ],
        frames=frames
    )
        
    # Map styling and playback controls
    title_text = f"{table_name}: {value_col} by county and year"
    fig = apply_map_layout_and_controls(fig, title_text, years)

    return fig

plot_county_coverage(df, "Busisness Patterns", "county coverage")

```

#### Values by County

```{python}
# create a choropleth map of counties for a set of desired variables in the df

# Update these:
eda_table_name = "NAICS 518 Establishments"
cols_to_use = [2]

## one map per column
for i in cols_to_use:
    value_col = cols[i]
    map_df = df[["year", "county_id", value_col]].dropna()

    ## Get unique years
    years = sorted(map_df["year"].dropna().unique())

    frames = []

    value_min = map_df[value_col].min()
    value_max = map_df[value_col].max()


    frames = []
    for year in years:
        df_year = map_df[map_df["year"] == year] # dropped .copy() for speed
        
        frames.append(
            go.Frame(
                data=[
                    go.Choroplethmap(
                        locations=df_year["county_id"],
                        z=df_year[value_col]
                    )
                ],
                name=str(int(year))
            )
        )

    if not frames:
        raise ValueError(f"No valid yearly data found for {value_col}")

    initial_year_df = map_df[map_df["year"] == years[0]]

    fig = go.Figure(
        data=[
            go.Choroplethmap(
                geojson=counties_geojson, 
                locations=initial_year_df["county_id"],
                z=initial_year_df[value_col],
                featureidkey="id",
                colorscale="Viridis",
                zmin=value_min,
                zmax=value_max,
                marker_opacity=0.5,
                marker_line_width=0.3,
                colorbar=dict(title=value_col),
                hovertemplate=f"County FIPS: %{{location}}<br>{value_col}: %{{z}}<extra></extra>"
            )
        ],
        frames=frames
    )
        
    ## Make it look nice
    title_text = f"{eda_table_name}: {value_col} by county and year"
    fig = apply_map_layout_and_controls(fig, title_text, years)

    fig.show()
```
